title.description: The title of the page that lists the events.

new.description: The button that opens the form of a new event, and the title of that form's dialog.

notFound.description: The error shown when an address names an event that does not exist.

newDescription.defaultMessage: You can add a picture and description after saving.
newDescription.description: The line under the title of the dialog that adds a new event: its picture and description are added after it is saved.

description.description: The line under the title of the page that lists the events: what the list is.

details.description: The tab of an event's page that holds its details, its picture and what is written about it.

allView.description: The name of the view of the events calendar that the admin starts with: every event, a month at a time. Shown as the first tab over the calendar, beside the views a user has saved.
